claim: The hosts describe a lightweight CRM or knowledge graph represented as linked markdown files.
Frontmatter and file structure are used to select context without asking the model to inspect every document.
A daily review SOP gathers source material and produces a comprehensive markdown review artifact.
The repository example keeps recurring output formats and procedures in written SOP files.
Shared markdown and comments can support collaboration when the workflow pulls feedback back into the local corpus.
For narrow integrations, the speakers prefer direct scripts and focused instructions over loading broad MCP tool sets.
